name: Cybersecurity and Duo
summary: Set up multifactor authentication and protect university information

details.title: Protect your account
details.html: York requires two-factor authentication for active student, employee, sponsored affiliate and eligible retiree accounts. Duo supplements the Passport York password with a second factor such as an app approval, code or supported hardware device

details.title: Report suspicious mail
details.html: York Gmail and Outlook include a Report Phishing control to send suspicious messages to Information Security. Do not interact with suspicious links, attachments or unexpected authentication prompts before reporting

details.title: Security services
details.html: UIT Information Security provides security consultation, incident handling, monitoring and vulnerability management, as well as processes for requesting certificates and guidance on malware and safe computing
